newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Istrabenz moved to main market.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Istrabenz moved to main market.

text.p: Shares of Slovenian petrol trader Istrabenz were moved to the Ljubljana stock exchange's main market from the over-the-counter (OTC) segment, the bourse said on Monday.
It said the move was made possible after the company presented audited business results for the past three years.
Istrabenz moved all 4.5 million shares, which were listed on the OTC in February and represent 87.05 percent of the company's equity.
By 1010 GMT, Istrabenz shares were down one percent at 2,800 tolars on volume of 39 shares.
Istrabenz is the Slovenian partner of Austrian oil and energy group OMV. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
